trend.methodology: Handler-Presence Heuristic (Over-optimistic classification allowing partial cards to be marked FULL)
Inherited Phase 3F matrix with static opcode regex matching
Strict Mathematical Audit: FULLY_SUPPORTED requires unsupportedAbCount === 0 across all clauses. 810 cards with unhandled secondary abilities reclassified from FULL to PARTIAL.

reconciliationAuditNotes.explanation: In Phase 4D, 810 cards were classified as FULLY_SUPPORTED even when one of their secondary abilities contained unimplemented opcodes (e.g. CP14-X14R had 3 abilities with only 2 supported). Phase 4D.1 strictly enforces that 100% of a card abilities must be supported for FULLY_SUPPORTED status.
